breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained conflicting boundary conditions: both Neumann (u_x=0) and Dirichlet (u=0) were specified for the same boundaries. The ground truth resolved this by removing the Dirichlet condition. The generated specification correctly identified this conflict and explicitly states to 'Enforce only zero Neumann boundary conditions', thus resolving the inconsistency in line with the ground truth.
